steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each channel's cost is matched to its contact count. Cost with no contacts is a gap.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 channel has cost but no contacts

findings.title: Channel with cost but no contacts
findings.fix: Close the channel or record its contacts

findings.title: Cost per contact does not follow from the figures

outcome.notChecked: Customer preference beyond the survey data.
